description: Lists companies on Remotejobb.se with their number of open jobs, website and company page, with paging. Without a name, companies with the most open jobs come first. With a name, companies are matched loosely (case, accents, punctuation and legal suffixes such as "AB" are ignored; every word must start a word of the company name) and the closest matches come first. The slug can be used as the company filter of search_jobs.

is_hiring.description: true: only companies with open jobs. false: also companies without open jobs.

language.description: Language for labels such as work mode and employment type. Job content is returned in its original language.

name.description: Company name to look for, e.g. "spotify" or "academic work".

name: list_companies
title: List companies
